title: Patterns on elliptic curves beyond Bremner's conjecture
summary: In the late 1990's, Bremner conjectured that long arithmetic progressions among the $x$-coordinates of rational points of an elliptic curve $E$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ should force the rank of $E$ to be large. This conjecture (and a broad generalization of it) was proved by the authors two decades later, by combining Nevanlinna theory and the Uniform Mordell--Lang theorem of Gao--Ge--Kühne. The proof inspired subsequent work by the authors where a generalization of the Bogomolov--Fu--Tschinkel conjecture was proved by similar means.
